title: Copilot Studio: Python Code node as a step in workflows
summary: The roadmap facts, workflow billing statements and capacity API are supported. Code-node-specific pricing, identity and controls remain undocumented in the sources checked. Minor corrections should complete the overage route and reconcile the monitoring checklist with the controls table.

claims.claim: The printed Power Platform admin center route reaches environment credit allocation on the Copilot Credits textbox.
claims.quote: Under the Copilot Studio heading, select Manage Copilot Credits or Manage sessions. In the allocation panel, select an environment and specify the number of Copilot Credits to allocate in the Copilot Credits textbox.
claims.fix: Keep the allocation path. To complete the same row's overage guidance, add to its note: 'For overages, follow Licensing > Products > Copilot Studio > Summary > Copilot Studio > Manage Copilot Credits > environment > Capacity overages, then select Draw from the available capacity in my tenant or Bill to my pay-as-you-go billing plan.' Both options are documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/manage-copilot-studio-copilot-credits-capacity.

claims.claim: PUT https://api.powerplatform.com/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=2024-10-01 writes the environment allocation.
claims.quote:
Invoke-RestMethod -Method Put `
    -Uri "$apiBaseUrl/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=$apiVersion" `

claims.claim: The allocation request uses enforcementRules with ruleType TenantPool to control tenant capacity draw.
claims.quote:
enforcementRules = @(
                # Disable TenantPool so the environment is capped at its allocation.
                # Set enabled = $true to let the environment draw from tenant capacity.
                @{ ruleType = "TenantPool"; enabled = $false }

claims.claim: Environment credit allocation and overage settings govern the capacity workflows draw on rather than constituting a Code-node-specific switch.
claims.quote: Administrators can allocate credits to environments and monitor usage to ensure that sufficient credits are available.

claims.quote: Select Bill to my pay-as-you-go billing plan to let the environment continue usage through the selected billing plan.
